semantics: boundary_values[time,masked_boundary_point,channel] contains only the 3-cell boundary; no future interior or pressure.
score: All future source frames 1..99, each reported separately and together as a full-window space-time error; raw interior [4:85,4:129]; conditional prediction.
boundary_history: Measured three-cell boundary strips at all 100 source frames 0..99; piecewise-linear interpolation between samples.
temporal_aggregation: Actual inter-frame time increments normalized over the prediction window; initial frame excluded.
